display_name: Ananias, companion of Simeon of Persia

names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 17 апреля ст. ст., name page 159, «Анания Селевкийский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the grade and the rank word left off; the day's line gives «Анании» in the genitive and no epithet. The city is the calendar's own nominative and is what tells him from the ten other folders this corpus keeps on the forename. No folder holds this form and the gate's key for it, «анания селевкиискии», has no other holder, measured.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Симеона , еп. Персидского, и с ним мчч. @6[Авделая] и Анании пресвитеров, Хусдазата евнуха, Фусика , Азата , мч. Аскитреи и иных многих (344).»
source.note: One of the six the day's first entry names, the second of its two presbyters, and the only one of the six with no folder in this corpus before this batch except the daughter of the kouropalates. The day's first entry, and the first of the three to carry a typikon icon, whose alt reads «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The line enumerates six of the company by name and closes «и иных многих», and many others, who are not named; the life counts a thousand martyrs, then another hundred and another hundred and fifty. **The day page's markup for the first presbyter is broken — it prints «@6[Авделая]», an unexpanded template, and he alone of the six has no `name:` link behind him**; the life's own heading gives his nominative. The name page for this entry (2001) gives «День памяти: 17 апреля» and no other day, and the «Служба» line under it names the three the day's service is for: Simeon, Acacius of Melitene and Zosimas of Solovki. The day's four hymns are two for Zosimas and two for the finding of another saint's relics, and none is this company's.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 17 апреля ст. ст. with «(344)», and its life for the company gives the year twice over: the decree that began the persecution in 344, and the bishop's own death «(+ 13 апреля 344)», with the killing going on through Pascha week to the twenty-third of April. This martyr died inside that week, so the year is his as well; the page gives him no other date and no birth, and the day it gives for the bishop is not his and is not recorded here.
